defs.def: feeling sure about your own ability to do things and be successful 自信的；有自信心的

ex.s: As Alice Black points out, today’s parents’ fear of letting kids do more housework has added to their inability to feel competent and, thus, confident in themselves.
ex.t: 正如Alice Black所指出的，当今父母害怕让孩子做更多家务，这加剧了他们无法感到胜任、从而无法自信的问题。

ex.s: Creative activities involve being confident.
ex.t: 创造性活动需要自信。

ex.s: Did they tend to go with those most confident about their estimates?
ex.t: 他们是否倾向于跟随那些对自己的估计最有信心的人？

ex.s: One in four adults say that TV chefs have made them much more confident about expanding their cookery knowledge and skills, and young people are also getting more interested in cooking.
ex.t: 四分之一的成年人说，电视上的厨师让他们对拓展自己的烹饪知识和技能更有信心，年轻人也对烹饪越来越感兴趣。

ex.s: Looking back, I now see that this would be the first in a series of timely opportunities that my old self would have let pass, but that this new and more confident Alice enthusiastically seized.
ex.t: 回想起来，我现在看到，这将是我以前的自我本来会放弃的一系列及时机会中的第一个机会，但是这个新的和更加自信的爱丽丝却热情地抓住了机会。

ex.s: A confident person.
ex.t: 一个自信的人。

ex.s: One self-deprecating comment is a generous and even confident form of humor.
ex.t: 一句自嘲的话是一种大方、甚至自信的幽默形式。

ex.s: But if you do it too often, you can transform in the eyes of others from a confident joker to a Chihuahua dog.
ex.t: 但如果你做得太频繁，在别人眼里就会从一个自信的玩笑者变成一只吉娃娃犬。

ex.s: All speakers were confident, comfortable with being seen.
ex.t: 后来有一天，我在一个大型会议上，突然像闪电一样受到了启发。

ex.s: Her voice was soft but confident as she pointed to the corner near the windows.
ex.t: 她用柔和但自信的声音指向窗户附近的角落。

ex.s: It helps one to remain clear-headed and confident in difficult situations.
ex.t: 它有助于人们在困难的情况下保持头脑清醒和自信。

ex.s: “Boasting about yourself，and your best qualities,” Whaley says，“is very difficult for a child who came into the classroom not feeling confident.”
ex.t: “夸自己，夸自己的优点，”惠利说，“对一个走进教室时毫无自信的孩子来说，是非常困难的。”

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

ex.s: Some of us were confident and eager take part in the class activity, others were nervous and anxious.
ex.t: 我们中有些人自信而渴望参加班级活动，其他人则紧张焦虑。

ex.s: （1分）At first Robert wouldn't let his daughter go diving， but eventually he               as she was so confident about her skills．（  ）
ex.t: 3．（1分）起初罗伯特不让女儿去潜水，但最终他____，因为她对自己的技术很自信。（  ）

ex.s: As the generation to have grown up in the Information Age, they are quite confident when it comes to showing off their interests and skills in this field.
ex.t: 作为在信息时代长大的一代人，他们在展示自己在这一领域的兴趣和技能时相当自信。

ex.s: “I feel more confident in my actions now,” Taylor says.
ex.t: “我现在对自己的行为更有信心了，”泰勒说。

ex.s: I felt I had become stronger and more confident and had made new friends.
ex.t: 我觉得自己变得更强、更自信了，还交到了新朋友。

ex.s: Improving your appearance can help others to have a positive opinion of you at first sight and also make you feel more confident about yourself.
ex.t: 改善外貌可以帮助他人在第一眼就对你有积极的看法，也让你对自己更有信心。

ex.s: Self-confidence What can you do to become more confident and feel better about yourself?
ex.t: 自信你可以做些什么来变得更加自信，对自己感觉更好？

ex.s: Do you feel more confident about writing an argumentative essay in English now?
ex.t: 您现在是否对用英语写一篇论证性文章更有信心？

ex.s: “It takes a lot for any student，” Whaley explains，“especially for a student who is learning English as their new language，to feel confident enough to say，‘I don’t know，but I want to know.’”
ex.t: “对任何学生来说都需要很大勇气，”惠利解释道，“尤其对一个把英语当作新语言来学的学生，要自信到能说‘我不知道，但我想知道’。”

defs.def: feeling certain that sth will happen in the way that you want or expect 肯定的；确信的；有把握的

ex.s: Although I wouldn’t bank on patients feeling confident about seeing a robot doctor any time soon, I’m sure that AI doctors are on the horizon.
ex.t: 虽然我不会指望患者很快就能放心地去看机器人医生，但我确信AI医生即将出现。

ex.s: "With our study, we think we can now confidently conclude that at least some dogs can distinguish human facial expressions," Muller told Live Science.
ex.t: "对我们来说最可能的解释是基础在于它们与人类的生活这给了它们大量接触人类面部表情的机会，"穆勒说而这种接触为它们提供了许多学习区分的机会。
